title: Headless TTW Tranquility Lane (MQ04): from the Tranquility Lounger in Vault 112 through the abandoned house's Failsafe (the Chinese invasion) back to Dad (stage 200, completed; MQ05 10)

actions.text: Start: MQ03 at stage 70 in Vault 112 with the Vault 112 suit on, MQ04 running at 0 (given, as ttw-mq03-scientific-pursuits leaves them before the lounger). The player takes the Tranquility Lounger. Engine gap (as in that chain): MQ04PlayerPodScript waits for GetSitting 3 near the pod and the headless runner has no step that seats the player, so MQ04's playerinchair is set to 2 as the stand-in for the pod closing; MQ04Script moves the player into Tranquility Lane (MQ03 200, MQ04 5).
Old Lady Dithers' greeting points at the abandoned house (its end script sets MQ04 10). The chain takes the Failsafe way out, not Betty's tasks (stages 15 to 60).

The abandoned house: the player plays the five objects in the tone sequence 5, 3, 4, 3, 2, 4, 1 (MQ04FailsafeObject scripts: failseq 1 to 8), which enables the Failsafe terminal (MQ04FailsafeTerminalRef).

The terminal's Chinese Invasion submenu: the player reads the Failsafe documentation (the entry that sets the terminal's own variable the Initiate entry asks for) and initiates the failsafe (invasion 1: MQ04Script resurrects the residents, enables the soldiers and the exit door, stage 70, MQ05 1).
Out through the exit door back to Vault 112 (MQ04Script: in Vault112a, stage 75).
Dad, out of his pod: the player answers and agrees to go back to Rivet City (MQ04DadLetsGo's end script: stage 200 completes MQ04 and sets MQ05 10).
